name: Pass data between steps with data pills
description: Learn how ByteChef steps share data. A Variable step holds a name and a city, a Text Helper step upper-cases the city, and a Logger step combines both into a greeting using data pills such as ${var_1.name}. It runs with one click and needs no connection.
shortDescription: Learn how ByteChef steps pass data to each other with data pills.
keyFeatures: Read a step's output and reuse it in a later step with a data pill
Transform a value with a Text Helper action
Combine plain text and several data pills in one field
idealFor: First-time ByteChef users who want to understand how steps share data before building their own workflows.
steps: Trigger: the workflow starts when you click Test in the workflow editor.
Set name and city: a Variable step returns an object with a name (Ada) and a city (Zagreb).
Make the city upper case: a Text Helper step takes ${var_1.city} and returns ZAGREB.
Log a greeting: the Logger writes "Hello Ada, welcome to ZAGREB!" using the ${var_1.name} and ${textHelper_1} data pills.
